clips.title: The story
paras: Illiyana Moonblaze is a night elf supply officer stationed at Silverwing Grove in Ashenvale. Operating alongside the Silverwing Sentinels, she supplies Alliance champions waging war against the Warsong Outriders.

Illiyana Moonblaze serves as the supply officer for the Silverwing Sentinels nestled in Silverwing Grove. From her post near the path into Warsong Gulch, she outfits the defenders who hold the southern woods of Ashenvale against the Warsong clan.

Beyond keeping the grove's stores, Illiyana equips Alliance volunteers preparing to clash with the Warsong clan in Warsong Gulch. As champions earn favor with the Silverwing Sentinels, she rewards their service with custom rations, specialized draughts, and masterwork armaments designed specifically for woodland skirmishes. She also maintains weapons and armor for weary fighters returning from the frontline, keeping the Sentinels' war effort supplied and functional.
